Balance checks for the causal forest sample. They do not depend on any forest, so they live here rather than in `Causal Forest.Rmd`. Both files read the analysis sample saved by `cleaned_data.Rmd` (`cleaned data.Rda`), so knit that one first.

# Setup and data preparation

```{r packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
required_packages <- c("estimatr", "dplyr", "knitr")
missing_packages  <- setdiff(required_packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
library(estimatr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
```

```{r load-data}
# cleaned_data.Rmd builds and saves the analysis sample (df_int1)
rda_path <- "cleaned data.Rda"
if (!file.exists(rda_path)) {
  stop("Cleaned data not found. Knit cleaned_data.Rmd first to create: ",
       normalizePath(rda_path, mustWork = FALSE))
}
loaded <- load(rda_path)
stopifnot("df_int1" %in% loaded)
```

```{r analysis-sample}
# Pre-treatment resume characteristics
all_pretreat_cov <- c(
  "language_skills",
  "female",
  "ba_quality",
  "extracurricular_skills",
  "ma",
  "same_exp",
  "exp_highquality"
)

# Missing values are NOT recoded in cleaned_data.Rmd: same_exp is NA for every resume in
# wave 2. The balance statistics below therefore use the observed resumes only, so the
# same_exp row covers waves 0-1.
# The wave is saved as a factor; use a numeric code (0, 1, 2).
df_int1 <- df_int1 %>%
  mutate(fall_data = as.numeric(as.character(fall_data)))

waves <- sort(unique(df_int1$fall_data))
```

# Covariate balance table

SMD = (mean in D=1 minus mean in D=0) / sqrt((var in D=1 + var in D=0) / 2). Rule of thumb: |SMD| < 0.1 counts as balanced. The p-value is from a firm-clustered regression of the variable on D. Wave is a three-level code, so it enters as one dummy per wave rather than as a numeric code. same_exp is only observed in waves 0-1 (the `missing` column counts the resumes without it), so its row is calculated on those waves only.

```{r balance-table}
smd <- function(x, d) {
  x1 <- x[d == 1]
  x0 <- x[d == 0]
  (mean(x1, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(x0, na.rm = TRUE)) /
    sqrt((var(x1, na.rm = TRUE) + var(x0, na.rm = TRUE)) / 2)
}

# One dummy per wave
df_bal <- df_int1
for (k in waves) df_bal[[paste0("wave_", k)]] <- as.numeric(df_bal$fall_data == k)

bal_vars <- c(all_pretreat_cov, paste0("wave_", waves))

balance_row <- function(v, dat) {
  x <- as.numeric(dat[[v]])
  p <- tryCatch({
    # lm_robust drops resumes where the variable is missing
    fit <- lm_robust(as.formula(paste(v, "~ D")), data = dat,
                     clusters = firmid, se_type = "CR2")
    unname(fit$p.value["D"])
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  # Percentages only make sense for 0/1 variables
  is_bin <- all(x[!is.na(x)] %in% c(0, 1))
  data.frame(variable = v,
             mean_D0  = mean(x[dat$D == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
             mean_D1  = mean(x[dat$D == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
             pct_D0   = if (is_bin) 100 * mean(x[dat$D == 0], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
             pct_D1   = if (is_bin) 100 * mean(x[dat$D == 1], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
             SMD      = smd(x, dat$D),
             p_clustered = p,
             n_missing = sum(is.na(x)))
}

bal_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(bal_vars, balance_row, dat = df_bal)) %>%
  mutate(flag = ifelse(abs(SMD) >= 0.1, "check", ""))

kable(bal_tab, digits = 3,
      col.names = c("variable", "mean D=0", "mean D=1", "% D=0", "% D=1",
                    "SMD", "p (clustered)", "missing", "flag"),
      caption = paste("Balance of resume characteristics by name type",
                      "(D = 1 foreign name); % columns shown for 0/1 variables"))
```

# Wave checks

The balance table shows treated share differs a lot by wave. These two checks ask whether that is a composition issue (which name types were sampled in which wave) or a randomisation problem within wave. (Whether the name penalty itself differs by wave is checked in `Causal Forest.Rmd`.)

## Wave composition

```{r wave-composition}
# Which name types appear in which wave?
print(table(wave = df_int1$fall_data,
            ethnicity = as.character(df_int1$name_ethnicity)))

# Treatment share and callback rate by wave
wave_tab <- df_int1 %>%
  group_by(wave = fall_data) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            treated_share    = mean(D),
            callback_rate_D0 = mean(as.numeric(callback)[D == 0]),
            callback_rate_D1 = mean(as.numeric(callback)[D == 1]),
            .groups = "drop")

kable(wave_tab, digits = 3, caption = "Treatment share and callback rate by wave")
```

## Balance within wave

```{r balance-within-wave}
# Difference between name types after absorbing wave fixed effects.
# Resumes where the variable is missing are dropped (same_exp: waves 0-1 only).
within_row <- function(v) {
  dat   <- df_int1
  dat$x <- as.numeric(dat[[v]])
  fit   <- lm_robust(x ~ D + factor(fall_data), data = dat,
                     clusters = firmid, se_type = "CR2")
  data.frame(variable         = v,
             diff_D1_minus_D0 = unname(coef(fit)["D"]),
             se               = unname(fit$std.error["D"]),
             p_clustered      = unname(fit$p.value["D"]))
}

within_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(all_pretreat_cov, within_row))

kable(within_tab, digits = 3,
      caption = paste("Balance within wave (name-type difference,",
                      "wave fixed effects, firm-clustered)"))
```
